$comment: The source of sf-toggle's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/toggle (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

x-summary: Deprecated: superseded by sf-switch, which draws the same control and carries both of Toggle's looks. A compact on/off control (a native checkbox with role="switch") kept only for markup already written; it is removed after 2026-11-01 (journal record component-toggle-to-switch).

ai_guidance.use_when: Do not use sf-toggle for new work; use sf-switch, which draws the same control (sf-switch--short and sf-switch--icon give Toggle's two looks). Keep sf-toggle only in markup already written until it is moved.
do_not: Do not use sf-toggle for new work; use sf-switch
Do not use Toggle for multiple-choice selection or a deferred form option
Do not use an unexplained icon as the only accessible name
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

x-replaced-by.note: the component itself is deprecated; aliases.json carries member renames only, the shim has no row for a tag

x-decisions: existing-aliases: the legacy axis name `type` leaves the settings and is a dated setting alias of `kind` (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01); the component-level replacement by sf-switch has no alias kind in the shim, so it stays in the change journal and x-replaced-by.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (the checked reference) plus the three kinds, disabled and size 2; probe.json drives Space (gate 16).

css-variables: five public variables, one per recolourable state (off track, checked track, border, label, gap); the state rules read them with the role token as fallback (§6). Also in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.
value defaults to "on": a checked toggle without value submits "on", as a native checkbox (§17.1 item 2, simai/ui-source#38 as for sf-switch).

form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals; the inner checkbox carries no name (§17.1 item 6); the checked look reads :has(input:checked) and the thumb side is written by the template, not by a script class (§5.3).
version 1.1.0: a renamed member behind a dated alias is a minor (§4.10, §16.20).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
